items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Yeah, and I played solo on that, even though I've had people that call me from out of town in different places and say they didn't have me listed as being on that session.

ctx.x: Fat Man, Fat Man, Fat Stomino.

Well, I think that might have been after we had done some things with Smiley Lewis. Maybe I'm wrong. I don't know. But that first recording with Fats Domino was a split session. Fats Domino had a split session with a lady by the name of Jill King. Mm-hmm. She had the hit record called Three Times Seven.
